surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves the alternating exposure of the substrate to hafnium tetrakis(dimethylamide) (Hf[N(CH3)2]4) and water (H2O). The surface reactions are primarily ligand exchange between the alkylamide groups and surface hydroxyl groups, followed by a water pulse to regenerate the OH sites. At higher temperatures, thermal decomposition of the precursor occurs, leading to the formation of HfO2 films with varying degrees of crystallinity and impurity content.
